plugin.name: Splinter Cell Widescreen Fix
MAIN.ResX.description: Output width; 0 uses the desktop resolution. Restart required.
MAIN.ResY.description: Output height; 0 uses the desktop resolution. Restart required.
MAIN.ForceShadowBufferMode.description: Force the game's shadow-buffer rendering mode.
MAIN.ShadowBufferResolution.description: 0 preserves the native shadow size, 1 uses output width, otherwise sets the size. Clamped to 4096 for renderer safety. Restart required.
MAIN.RawInputMouse.description: Read mouse movement without the original dropped events. Restart required.
MAIN.RawInputMouseRawData.description: Use unaccelerated mouse movement. Restart required.
MAIN.FMVWidescreenMode.description: Keep the original video aspect ratio, crop to fill the screen, or stretch to the screen. Applies immediately.
MAIN.HudWidescreenMode.description: Use the original HUD position, a fixed widescreen offset, or the screen edges.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Auto uses the full screen width. Set a ratio such as 4:3, 16:9 or 21:9 to keep the HUD in a centered area. Applies immediately.
MAIN.GrainScale.description: Vision grain scaling: 0 uses original scaling, 1 scales to the 640x480 baseline. Restart required.
MAIN.SkipIntro.description: Skip startup logos and intro playback. Play Intro remains available from the main menu.
MAIN.SkipPressStartToContinue.descriptio: Go past the startup button prompt automatically.
MAIN.RestoreCutsceneFOV.description: Keep story cutscenes at their original field of view.
MAIN.CutsceneBorders.description: Keep the original cinematic bars, remove them, or adapt them to the screen aspect ratio.
MISC.FPSLimit.description: Frame limit; 0 disables the fix limiter. 60 preserves the shipped recommendation; higher rates can affect AI and physics. Restart required.
MAIN.DeferredInput.description: Process mouse movement during the game update instead of inside the window message handler.
INPUT.Joy1.description: Native Engine.Input command string copied to SplinterCellUser.ini on startup. Restart required.

menu.title: Advanced Options
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language tag for Advanced Options and other plugins. auto follows the game language. Edit in the hub or CFG, then reopen Advanced Options.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a centered window, or borderless covering the monitor. Takes effect when the game starts. Alt+Enter switches fullscreen and the chosen window style.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the normal gameplay camera field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Scripted, aiming and gadget cameras keep their own framing.
MAIN.MouseSensitivity.description: Movement multiplier for raw mouse input. Applies immediately; preserves your choice when presets change.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restore this plugin's settings. Press twice to confirm.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset and press twice to apply it to this plugin.
